description: Techno-economic data for decentralized energy system sizing for rural areas in Benin. A case study of the village of Fouay. is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. This data article is related to the research article “O.D.T. Odou, R. Bhandari, R. Adamou, Hybrid off-grid renewable power system for sustainable rural electrification in Benin, Renew. Energy. 145 (2020) 1266–1279. doi:10.1016/j.renene.2019.06.032.’’. The data are grouped into 4 categories spread in different worksheets as follow: 1. Coverage: Benin. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Energy Engineering, Energy Systems, Renewable Energy System Design. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
